result.reason: The added operative language reaches the preferred position: Client retains ownership of its content, IP and data; TrueLink presently assigns Client-specific deliverables and Support Services results; TrueLink retains its pre-existing IP and Interface; Client receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded TrueLink IP; and joint ownership is expressly excluded. The amendment is limited to the necessary ownership allocation and preserves TrueLink’s existing Interface ownership. Drafting is professional, though the embedded-IP licence could be slightly clearer by expressly covering all permitted use of the deliverables rather than limiting use to “in connection with Client’s business.”
